pages.text: The Factory Must Grow brings the age of $(item)steel$(), $(item)oil$() and $(item)electricity$() to Create.$(br2)Each chapter follows the order you will build things in. Read them in order the first time, then come back to any chapter when you need it.

$(li)Every multiblock has a $(item)3D view$() page. Press $(item)Visualize$() on it to project the structure as a ghost in front of you: missing and wrong blocks are shown until it is complete. $(li)The last page of an entry shows the $(item)items$() it talks about; hover them for details, and use JEI for their recipes.

$(li)Use the $(item)search$() bar on the contents page, and bookmark the pages you use most. $(li)Stuck? Right-click the machine with the $(item)Factory Inspector$(): it tells you what works, what stops it and what to do. $(li)$(item)Factory Blueprints$() project a multiblock into the world layer by layer. They are rare:
look in village workshop chests, or buy one from a master cartographer. Each covers one assembly line.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
